authorityDisclaimer: ANALYTICAL / PLANNING / GOVERNANCE ONLY. This artifact authorises NO product implementation, no migration, no deployment, no destructive cleanup, no infrastructure change, no protected-boundary crossing, no chapter entry, no chapter closure and no state promotion. Chapter authorisation and chapter closure remain founder-only; roadmap approval is never chapter authorisation. Every wave, gate, band and readiness value below is a PROPOSAL for founder ratification.
governingQuestionAnswered: Aura's 17 executable reconstruction chapters are constructed, validated and certified in SEVEN dependency-derived waves plus TWO concurrent lanes, not in chapter-number order. A flat CH-01..CH-17 ordering is rejected because it contradicts the recorded dependency edges: at least three declared edges run backwards against the chapters' own wave labels, the smallest chapter in the portfolio (CH-15, one finding, one obligation) is a hard prerequisite of the most destructive one (CH-12), and the two chapters with ZERO findings (CH-07, CH-08) carry 38 chartered obligations that a defect-ordered plan would never schedule. The ordering is driven by five forces in this priority: eliminate the systemic causes that would otherwise be re-solved locally in every dependent (continuity, content truth, identity consumption, attention, moderation policy); never build a presentation, funnel or publication layer over an unresolved truth; keep every irreversible act (deletion, disclosure, distribution, migration) behind founder-observed gates; discharge certification inside the wave that produced the work rather than in a terminal validation phase; and prevent an unresolved founder decision from becoming an implementation assumption.

readinessVocabulary.note: The eight dimensions are reported SEPARATELY and are never collapsed into a single READY / NOT_READY verdict. A chapter may be ready to build and blocked for certification; may have complete authorities and outstanding product convergence; may be product-ready and blocked by release infrastructure.

values.READY: No recorded condition prevents this dimension from proceeding now, beyond the universal precondition.
values.READY_WITH_CONDITIONS: May proceed once a named condition inside the plan holds; the condition is stated on the dimension.
values.BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY: Blocked on a bounded deliverable owned by another chapter.
values.BLOCKED_FOUNDER: Blocked on a founder decision, declaration, ratification or authorisation. No engineering act discharges it.
values.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Blocked on an external or infrastructure action no agent may take (Cloudflare dashboard, production deploy, store submission, real devices).
values.BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENTAL: Blocked on a coordination or environment condition (a convened multi-identity session, a machine that can run the tool, an uninterrupted founder browser window).
values.BLOCKED_CONSTRUCTION: The named validation or certification target does not exist yet; scheduling it as validation would be a category error.
values.NOT_EARNABLE_HERE: The layer is structurally earned in another chapter; claiming it locally is prohibited (PB-10).
values.NOT_APPLICABLE: No recorded mechanism by which this dimension applies to this chapter.
values.CONFLICTED: Two authoritative records disagree; preserved as a conflict rather than adjudicated.
values.UNKNOWN: The evidence does not establish it; absence of a record is not evidence of a state.

effortBandDefinitions.rule: Bands are BOUNDED CLASSIFICATIONS of construction and certification weight derived from recorded structural facts - number of coherent sub-systems, whether the capability exists at all, protected-boundary contact, irreversibility, repository span, and how many distinct validation topologies the work needs. They are NOT durations, NOT effort estimates, NOT story points and NOT convertible into dates. Two chapters in the same band are not claimed to be equal in any measurable sense.
effortBandDefinitions.SHORT: One coherent system or one governed artifact. Nothing structurally unbuilt. No protected-boundary contact requiring per-slice sign-off. No migration, no deployment, no irreversible act. Its evidence is producible inside a SINGLE validation session or is founder-authored rather than engineered.
effortBandDefinitions.MEDIUM: One coherent system with material construction, OR one governed convergence with a bounded inventory. At most one protected boundary touched under a class already authorised by doctrine. No irreversible migration. Evidence spans one or two validation sessions and at most two topologies.
effortBandDefinitions.LARGE: Multiple sub-systems, or a demolition/convergence requiring per-slice founder sign-off, or cross-repository construction, or a data migration executed under founder observation. Evidence spans several sessions across more than two topologies, and at least one layer of the certification ladder is structurally PARTIAL until a later chapter runs.
effortBandDefinitions.VERY_LARGE: A capability that does not exist at product scale AND an irreversible operational surface AND a fan-in exit gate or a protected boundary whose regression has already made production unusable. Work spans both repositories and, in the largest cases, external infrastructure with founder-only steps sitting on the critical path.
effortBandDefinitions.bandIsNotPriority: Band never drives order. CH-15 is SHORT and is scheduled early because it is a hard prerequisite of the F137 remediation; CH-13 is VERY_LARGE and is scheduled third because moving it earlier constructs temporary architecture. Ordering by band would invert both.

structuralFindings.title: THE RELEASE CRITICAL PATH RUNS THROUGH ONE FOUNDER DECLARATION

Any delay to that declaration propagates through three chapters to the release gate, and no engineering act shortens it.
structuralFindings.classificationBasis: DETERMINISTIC_DERIVATION on CO-RC-C9-030's text and on the frozen RC-C10 gate; ANALYTICAL_INFERENCE on the chain composition.
structuralFindings.consequenceIfWrong: If CO-RC-C9-030's 'C4 and C5' is read as historical rather than as a live gate, CH-16 could enter earlier and the chain shortens. But reading it as stale is precisely 'scheduling around an unmet precondition', which the founder ratification forbids by name. This artifact therefore treats the gate as LIVE regardless of the staleness of its wording.

contradictions.type: AN OPEN SCOPE QUESTION THAT A LATER RULING APPEARS TO ANSWER
contradictions.statement: CH-11's founderActions record the RC-C5 hard-gate SCOPE question as NOT_RECORDED and founder-only, and state that it determines whether the chapter may run now. The founder's BIFURCATED ruling of 2026-08-18 states that the gate does not retroactively govern systems frozen later, and the section 12 contract froze 2026-08-17 - one day after the gate.

contradictions.consequence: It determines whether the entire backend content track can occupy W1 or must wait behind the attention chapter.

contradictions.type: SIBLING ARTIFACTS PLACE THE SAME OWED CONDITIONS AT DIFFERENT POINTS
contradictions.statement: One sibling makes the PBCR 7-8 discharge a CH-04 ENTRY condition; another places it at the EXIT of the first gate that re-enters PB-02, reasoning that the regression evidence requires a real two-identity window the gate already convenes.
